mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in corporate demand (GDPC1) signals stronger earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.5% triggers concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of UNRATE above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in corporate demand (GDPC1) create a dual easing signal, accelerating growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS falls and GDPC1 rises.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent easing in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) and improving labor conditions (UNRATE decline) signal dual growth drivers, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS falls and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained growth in corporate demand (GDPC1) indicates near-capacity utilization, driving upward pressure on equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and corporate supply growth (INDPRO) signals tightening monetary policy paired with robust production, potentially boosting long-term growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) signals rebuilding supply chains and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during post-shock recovery periods when INDPRO rises.
